name: Karasu
effect: [When Attacking] You may trash 2 cards from the top of your deck: If your opponent has 7 or more cards in their hand, your opponent trashes 1 card from their hand.

official_faq.question: Which player chooses what cards are trashed when this card's [When Attacking] effect is activated?
official_faq.answer: The opponent of the player who used this [When Attacking] effect will choose 1 card to trash from their hand.

official_faq.question: If my opponent has 6 or less cards in their hand, can I still use this card's [When Attacking] effect to trash 2 cards from the top of my deck?
official_faq.answer: Yes, you can. In this case, since your opponent does not have 7 or more cards in their hand, your opponent will not trash any cards from their hand.
